status: workload/resource contract delivered; correctness smoke checked separately; no performance acceptance

resources.format: record actual envelope/Superblock/local codec versions per binary; recreate each version from identical logical data
resources.durability: never disable sync; record acknowledgement boundary per engine

holdout.purpose: untuned seed/dimensions implemented; authenticated CSV manifest frozen

datasets.manifest: hash every input and record schema/indexes/types; freeze operation sequence and expected state before timing

sampling.aggregation: median of independent process P50s; retain each process distribution and min/max P50; never pool as independent observations
sampling.tail_policy: 10-sample P95 is descriptive only; threshold decisions need targeted extended sampling
sampling.stop_rule: if within 5 percentage points of gate or control P50 range exceeds 5 percent, add at most 2 independent processes with 100 samples; tail-sensitive steady-state requires at least 1000 observations/process; stop at 30 minutes per case; unresolved becomes inconclusive
cache_modes: warm: three warmups; OS cache not flushed
fresh-open: open included, OS cache remains
cold: only with explicit isolated VM/cache reset evidence, never equate process restart with cold
sampling.order: control/current/Kuzu; current/Kuzu/control; Kuzu/control/current; profiling in separate processes

targets.performance_gate: at least 10 percent reproducible end-to-end P50 reduction versus frozen control
targets.architecture_probe: report 2x and 10x milestones without claiming they are guaranteed; record residual Kuzu ratio; no cumulative-small-gain success claim
targets.kuzu: same semantics/resources; unsupported N/A; entry/binding overhead disclosed

protections.latency: no stable P50/P95 regression over 5 percent outside control variation; descriptive P95 cannot alone prove protection
protections.resources: no memory cap increase; report RSS, charged query memory, read/write bytes, file size, retirement backlog; stable growth over 5 percent requires explicit tradeoff decision

correctness: IDs, typed values, null versus missing, multiplicity, required order
separate validation from timing; full observed output still consumed inside timing
mutations: post-state, indexes, reopen, old snapshot, constraints, failure publication
budget/read-only/cancel/ENOSPC/crash: defined error, no partial output advertised as success, scratch cleanup

experiments: same input through typed versus generic execution
Top-K versus full sort with identical ordering semantics
trusted adjacency candidate versus current authenticated backlookup only after protocol acceptance
attribution.falsification: timer nesting not summed; instrumentation separate from formal timing; mechanism improvements without end-to-end gain do not pass

cleanup: task containers/images/volumes only; no global prune
temporary CSV/database/build copies removed by owned manifest
bounded logs/raw samples plus compressed control retained
